definitions.full: H1982. helek הֵ֫לֶךְ noun masculine traveller (properly a going, journey , whence wayfarer, traveller ) only הֶעָשִׁיר לְאִישׁ הֵלֶךְ וַיָּבאֹ 2Sam 12:4 (|| לוֺ הֵבָּא הָאִישׁ לוֺ, הַבָּא הָאֹרֵחַ ); — in ᵑ0 1Sam 14:26 ׳ה דְּבָשׁ, הֵלֶךְ must be construct & = flowing , or dropping ( of honey ), but read rather ᵐ5 הָלַךְ The Klo We Dr (& דְּבֹּרוֺ for דְּבַשׁ q. v., ᵐ5 We Dr).
